$\pi_1(X)\simeq\pi_1(S')\times\pi_1(B)$};

\Tx{$Z\subset F$：$A$ の単純性と無限巡回像}{For $Z\subset F$: simplicity of $A$ and its infinite cyclic image}};
\flow{a}{b}{\Tx{四点補間と次元計算で正次元fiberを $F$ 内に制限}{Four-point interpolation forces\\positive-dimensional fibers into $F$}\\\Cite{complete-intersection}};

\Tx{$\widetilde X$ に正次元コンパクト解析部分多様体なし}{No positive-dimensional compact analytic subvariety in $\widetilde X$}\\

\flow{c}{d}{\Tx{Stein曲面のCW次元は実2以下；閉部分多様体へ適用}{A Stein surface has CW dimension at most two;\\apply to the closed submanifold}\\\Cite{stein-obstruction}\\\Cite{milnor-input}};
